page.layout: One page of text in a single column with an engraving (woodcut of a man bound to a stake in flames) set into the left half of the text block; marginal notes in the left margin (Martyrol., Apologet., Lib. De pudicit.) and the right margin (Tertullianus explicatus); running head at top; page number at top right; signature line "L" and "CAP." at the foot.

main_text.l: dixit, Relinquite me sic, qui enim dedit exspectare ignem,
dabit & sine vestra clauorum firmitate, so-
lutum manere in rogo. Illi autem non confixerunt
eum, sed ligarunt. Quin vno etiam tempore plures,
Schema inuersum) capite verso deorsum, suffocati fumo,
& lento igne consumpti sunt. Non ergo iniuria

l.i: & Semaxios appelletis, quòd ad stipitem dimidij

main_text.l: constrictum, id est, ad incendium iam cum homine ligatum.

page.notes: The engraving (man bound to a stake amid flames and smoke) is not transcribed as text. Marginal notes placed by their approximate line positions. Some words in the first lines are uncertain in the italic type.
